nodes.label: Read-Only Forensic Safety Model
nodes.rationale: All modules are strictly read-only to allow safe execution on production/personal machines without risk of modification, enabling triage without introducing new risk vectors.

nodes.label: Explainable Deterministic Scoring Principle
nodes.rationale: triggered_rules field is preserved on every scored process so analysts can audit exactly which heuristics fired, avoiding black-box opacity in security tooling.

nodes.label: triggered_rules Evidence Field Pattern
nodes.rationale: Each scoring rule appends a human-readable string to triggered_rules, providing audit-friendly transparency that satisfies both defensive security requirements and employer interview demonstration needs.
